searchText: Thanks Paul! I am grateful to you! in this approach a proposer should make the last aggregation step by concatenating aggregates received from different subnets. it can be a p2p constraint that an aggregate in the attestation_aggregates topic must contain signatures of only one committee. i don't see this approach increasing dos surface anyhow I am in support of that as I have been independently thinking on a solution to pack aggregates more tightly. It can increase block capacity in a way that 8 slots of good aggregates can be accommodated instead of 2 as of today without increasing its size in bytes (this is with 900k validators -- the number of slots accommodated with no size increase will be lower with bigger validator set) Potential approach on more efficient on chain aggregate: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3559#issuecomment-1911592486 What if we increase source timeliness to say 16 slots. What could get wrong with it? <#595701173944713277> is the most suitable channel imo cc <@750824368438771842>
